'''Chris Green''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Folsom tournament]] on 15 October 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA Interceptors]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1361">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-18-folsom-ca-10-15d1361/ folsom-ca-10-15], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 18 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-18-folsom-ca-10-15d1361/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
